Choosing Your First Marketing Automation Workflow

Find one repetitive task where a thoughtful workflow can save time.

By DIGITAL ARUNNov 22, 20265 min read
IN THIS ARTICLE
Map the current taskKeep human checksTest before expanding
Sample educational content. Edit or approve before launch.

Find one repetitive task where a thoughtful workflow can save time.

Map the current task

Write down each step from first inquiry to follow-up. Look for delays, repeated copying, and missing handoffs.

Keep human checks

Automation can prepare messages or move information, but a person should review decisions that require context, accuracy, or care.

Test before expanding

Try the workflow with a small group of cases. Check timing, errors, privacy, and how customers experience the result.
